paper_title: The Unseen Targets of Hate -- A Systematic Review of Hateful   Communication Datasets
caption: Conceptualized and operationalized targets by year along with the distribution of datasets. Targeted refers to datasets that have explicitly mentioned at least one target in their construct definition (i.e., in the conceptualization phase) and/or publications in which the authors define concrete measures to ensure and validate the presence of at least one target group in the data (i.e., in the operationalization phase). Untargeted refers to all other datasets that do not meet these two criteria. Note that the data for 2022 is only partially available (as described in our Methods and Data Section).
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the number of datasets categorized as “Targeted” or “Untargeted” across the years 2012 to 2022. The horizontal axis represents the years 2012 through 2022, arranged linearly, while the vertical axis displays the number of datasets, ranging from 0 to 160, with tick intervals of 20 units. The “Targeted” bar is blue and reaches a height of approximately 140 units, peaking in 2017, decreasing to approximately 40 units in 2018, and increasing to approximately 140 units in 2021 and 2022; the “Untargeted” bar is orange and ranges in height from approximately 10 to 130 units. The “Targeted” bar is segmented into four sections corresponding to the years 2014, 2015, 2016, 2019, 2020, and 2021, with the shortest segment representing 2014 and its height being approximately 10 units, and the tallest segment representing 2021, with a height of approximately 140 units.  The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
